metadata.description: Cross-project Claude Code skills and shared assets (slide templates, figure conversion, etc.)

plugins.name: slide-figure
plugins.description: Converts a publication-style R figure (ggplot2 or base R) into a presentation-ready slide figure matching the deck theme

plugins.name: session-start-hook
plugins.description: Creates SessionStart hooks that install dependencies so tests and linters work in Claude Code on the web sessions

plugins.name: close-session
plugins.description: Slash command that logs the session's changes to the repo's changelog (matching its existing format), then commits and pushes
